examples.label: Newsletter sign-up row with a subscribe button
examples.source:
Get the monthly changelog

One email a month with everything we shipped. No sales pitches, unsubscribe in one click.

<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" id="form-newsletter" for={%{}} form_wrapper_class="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-end"> <.component component_name="chelekom-email-field" site="Global" id="email-newsletter" name="email" value="" size="medium" space="small" label="Email address" placeholder="you@company.com" class="w-full" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary" type="submit" size="medium"> Subscribe

examples.label: Account settings email with a validation error
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" id="form-account-email" for={%{}} space="medium" class="mx-auto max-w-md">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-email-field" site="Global" id="email-account-settings" name="user[email]" value="sara@mishka" size="medium" space="small" variant="default" color="danger" label="Work email" placeholder="you@company.com" description="Billing receipts and security alerts are sent to this address." errors={["Enter a valid email address"]} />

  <:actions>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary" type="submit" size="small">
      Save changes
    </.component>
  </:actions>
</.component>

examples.label: Early-access waitlist field with a floating label
examples.source:
Join the private beta

We are letting in about fifty teams a week.

<.component component_name="chelekom-email-field" site="Global" id="email-waitlist" name="waitlist_email" value="" size="medium" space="small" rounded="full" floating="outer" label="Email address" class="text-start"> <:start_section> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-envelope" class="size-4" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary" rounded="full" class="mt-4" full_width> Request an invite

examples.label: Contact form with email and message
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" id="form-contact" for={%{}} space="medium" variant="bordered" color="natural" rounded="large" padding="medium" class="mx-auto max-w-lg">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="contact-name" name="name" value="" size="medium" space="small" label="Your name" placeholder="Sara Ahmadi" />

  <.component component_name="chelekom-email-field" site="Global" id="email-contact-form" name="email" value="" size="medium" space="small" label="Email address" placeholder="you@company.com" description="We reply to every message within one business day." />

  <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="contact-message" name="message" value="" size="medium" space="small" rows="5" label="How can we help?" placeholder="Tell us a little about your project" />

  <:actions>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary" type="submit" icon="hero-paper-airplane">
      Send message
    </.component>
  </:actions>
</.component>
